app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: Buona
body:
Applicazione è fatta molto bene. 
Molto utile per creare delle abitudini ed avere degli obiettivi quotidiani o setttimanali.
E’ tra l’altro l’unica che anche con la versione free si riesce a farne un buon uso.
author: DaveJP_

app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: CONSIGLIATISSIMA
body: Ho scaricato Timecap per provare ad avere una routine più ordinata e precisa, ed è effettivamente ciò che l’app fa! Grazie ai timer e i cronometri, puoi tenere monitorata la tua vita, osservando gli sbagli e i miglioramenti. CONSIGLIATISSIMA!!
author: missyenvy

app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: App is great, but needs some adjustments
body:
The app is great, I Iove the tools and the intuitive workflow. On the other side I would expect the stats to be more detailed and creative. This would make it easier to users to have a better overview of the reached goals/ failed goals and therefore stats could help to visualize the users attitude towards his goals.  

I’ll keep using the app and hope to get some updates soon!
author: ME NE FREGOO

app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: The app I was looking for years
body: Well done. Curated app with a pleasant UI, does its job.
author: Nicola1337

app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: The best time and habit tracker!
body: I’ve tried all the others and they were always missing something. This one is just perfect.
author: Javier Kurzynski

app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: Ottimo app!
body:
I have been using this app for few days for organising my tasks and tracking their progress. It helps to follow my goals amazingly. It is a must if you struggle to accomplish your daily tasks. 

Only one thing: It would be great if you integrate it with Apple Watch so we users can control the app without picking our distracting phone.
author: mstf2196
